title: The Shrine Cat
text: A fat old cat sleeps on the altar steps, grey and scarred, one eye milky. The priests say it is holy and has lived here longer than any of them. It opens its good eye and looks at you. It is very hungry.

options.label: Feed the holy cat; it has outlived every priest here.

outcomes.text: It purrs, a sound too deep for its size, and the priests bless the party.

options.label: Whoever it chooses pets it, hoping to be chosen kindly.

outcomes.text: It allows this, blinking slowly at them.

options.label: Shoo it off the steps; it is only a cat.

outcomes.text: The priests are horrified. The cat watches you all the way out.
